description: Tests whether Uptime Kuma can reach a Docker daemon, without saving anything. On success the message gives the number of containers. Use it before createDockerHost or updateDockerHost.

dockerDaemon.description: Unix socket path or TCP URL to probe

dockerType.description: "socket" for a unix socket path, "tcp" for an HTTP/HTTPS URL

name.description: Display name (used only in the test request)

name: testDockerHost
title: Test Docker Host
